name: max_demand_kind_filter
doc: I-3(c): runCase calls energy.MaxDemand(window, readings) exactly as production's maxDemandInWindow does (billing.go) — never with resets. This fixture instead proves MaxDemandKinds' kind filter with a current_index reading INSIDE the readings pool: it sits strictly between the two load_profile boundary readings (so SelectBoundary never picks it — SelectBoundary has no opinion on kind and the caller must have already filtered, I-17) and carries a higher max_demand_kw than either load_profile reading. Dropping the kind filter in MaxDemand must let it win.
